answer: A bond is refunded only after 33 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The meadow counter is kept in oasis and copper shows each reset. Someone as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 33 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4720 identities would post 558 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
